title: SME Sales Executive
description:
**Role : SME Sales Executive**

**Location :** MG Road, Bangalore (In-House)  
**Reporting to :** SME Sales Lead (UK) / SME Sales Shift Lead  
**Markets Covered:** US-Canada  
**Tools Used :** Zendesk (calls, tickets), Calendly, Company Platform

**About the** Company is an online services marketplace connecting customers with professionals across over 1,000 categories. Operating in nine countries including the UK, US, Australia, Canada, and New Zealand, we're transforming how people find trusted service providers for everything from home improvement to professional services.  
Our platform uses cutting-edge technology to match customers with the right professionals quickly and efficiently. We're currently undergoing an exciting transformation: migrating from a lead generation model to a full marketplace platform with subscription-based pricing.  
As a profitable, PE backed scale up (EMK Capital), Company offers the best of both worlds: the agility and innovation of a fast-moving business combined with financial stability and resources for growth. We recently launched our new marketplace model in Australia (Q4 2025) and are preparing for rollout to the UK and US markets in 2026. You'll have genuine ownership, responsibility, and the opportunity to shape our commercial strategy during a pivotal transformation phase with the chance to make your own contribution to our journey.

**Role Overview**

The **SME Sales Executive** is a front-line sales role responsible for engaging small and medium-sized businesses (SMEs) who have shown interest in Company’s platform. This role combines **outbound cold calling**, **live selling and activation**, and **onboarding conversations** to help sellers start winning work through Company.

Sales Executives will speak to business owners across global English-speaking markets, build trust quickly, clearly explain Company’s value, and guide sellers toward either booking an onboarding session or activating directly on the call.

This role requires confidence on the phone, strong communication skills, resilience, and the ability to follow structured sales processes while delivering a high-quality seller experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Outbound Sales & Cold Calling**

· Make high-volume outbound calls to sellers using Zendesk

· Engage new and lapsed sellers through structured cold-calling frameworks

· Confidently explain Company’s value proposition (for both lead-gen and marketplace model)

· Handle common objections and move conversations forward.

· Determine whether the best next step is:

o Booking an onboarding meeting, or

o Activating and selling on the call

**Meeting Booking & Scheduling**

· Book onboarding or follow-up meetings using Calendly.

· Guide sellers through availability using simple, conversational questions:

o “Which day works best for you?”

o “Morning or afternoon?”

· Confirm meeting details clearly and professionally.

· Send follow-up emails with Calendly links when sellers cannot commit immediately.

**Live Selling & Seller Activation**

· Activate sellers directly on a call or during pre-booked activation calls.

· Explain pricing, credits, lead flow, and value clearly and confidently.

· Help sellers select the right categories, locations, and lead settings.

· Ensure sellers understand best practices before purchasing leads.

· Maintain compliance with approved scripts, pricing, and offers.

**Onboarding Calls**

· Conduct onboarding calls with sellers who have already booked meetings.

· Walk sellers through:

o Activation and start pack options (if required)

o Profile setup

o Lead settings and filters

o Buying and responding to leads

o Best practices to maximise conversion

· Answer questions and remove friction during early platform usage.

· Deliver a positive, consultative seller experience.

**Systems, Process & Data Accuracy**

· Accurately log all call outcomes, notes, and actions in Zendesk.

· Use correct dispositions for unanswered calls, voicemails, callbacks, and meetings booked.

· Follow outbound cadence rules (call attempts, voicemail, email follow-ups).

· Adhere to compliance, quality, and communication standards.

**Key Skills & Experience**

· 1–3 years’ experience in outbound sales, inside sales or customer support.

· Comfortable making cold calls to business owners and decision-makers.

· Clear, neutral, and confident spoken English suitable for global markets.

· Strong objection-handling and conversational selling skills.

· Ability to follow structured scripts while sounding natural and authentic.

· Comfortable using CRM or ticketing tools (Zendesk experience is a plus).

· Resilient, target-driven, and comfortable handling rejection.

· Willingness to work aligned to US/UK business hours.

**Working Hours & Availability**

· If supporting US-Canada - Shift 08:00 PM IST to 05:00AM IST

· If supporting UK-Ireland - Shift 12:30PM IST to 09:30PM IST

· If supporting Australia-New Zealand - Shift 05:00AM IST to 02:00PM IST  
**Perks and Benefits**

· Flexible working policy with India office located in CBD Bangalore

· Insurances - Family Floater Mediclaim, Employee Personal Accident and Employee Term Life

· Personal annual L&D Budgets to spend on your development

· **Cult.fit** membership for all employees with access to mental health courses and fitness classes

· Fully stocked snacks in pantry, Quarterly All-site Socials

· Being at the forefront of an industry with new and exciting problems to solve

**Interview Process**

· Screening with Talent Partner

· 1st Stage - Interview with Hiring Manager (30 mins)

· 2nd Stage - Technical Task & Interview (60 mins

3rd Stage - Values interview (30 mins)

title: Business Development & Client Acquisition Specialist
description:
**TWILIGHT GREY TALENT**

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Business Development & Client Acquisition Specialist – Healthcare**

We are looking for a results-driven Business Development & Client Acquisition Specialist to develop healthcare employer opportunities across the UAE and wider Middle Eastern markets.

The primary focus of this role will be to identify healthcare workforce demand, map potential employers, reach relevant decision-makers, generate and qualify employer opportunities, secure high-quality meetings and build a structured client pipeline that enables the COO/Management to undertake focused business visits across the Middle East.

The successful candidate will build the market intelligence and opportunity pipeline from Bangalore, prepare the ground for client visits, support the COO before and during business visits, and drive structured follow-up after meetings to progress opportunities towards recruitment mandates, commercial proposals and contracts.

The role requires demonstrable B2B client acquisition experience and prior exposure to Middle Eastern healthcare employers, preferably with strong UAE market knowledge.

A particular focus will be placed on opportunities for Specialist Nurses, EMTs, Paramedics, Emergency Medical Services (EMS) professionals and other allied healthcare professionals, alongside broader healthcare workforce requirements.

1. Middle East Healthcare Market Development

· Identify and map healthcare employers across the UAE as the primary market, followed by Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman and Kuwait.

· Build and maintain a structured database of target organisations, decision-makers, workforce requirements and business opportunities.

· Map hospitals and hospital groups, medical centres and clinics, home healthcare providers, rehabilitation centres, aged-care and senior-living organisations, long-term care providers, specialist healthcare organisations, ambulance and emergency medical service providers, and relevant healthcare support/workforce-service organisations.

· Identify opportunities specifically related to EMTs, Paramedics, Advanced Paramedics, Emergency Medical Services and ambulance personnel.

· Identify potential opportunities within Civil Defence, ambulance and emergency-response organisations and related public-sector or government-linked entities, subject to applicable procurement and regulatory requirements.

· Identify current and upcoming workforce requirements for nurses, EMTs, paramedics, allied healthcare professionals and other relevant categories.

· Develop a practical understanding of country-wise healthcare markets, healthcare systems, employer structures and workforce requirements.

· Identify HR, Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, Workforce Planning, Operations, Procurement and other relevant decision-makers.

· Maintain up-to-date market intelligence on target employers and emerging workforce demand.

2. Prospecting & Client Outreach

· Identify prospective healthcare employers through structured market research, professional networks, LinkedIn, industry sources, databases and other appropriate channels.

· Identify and verify relevant decision-makers within target organisations.

· Conduct structured outbound business development through email, LinkedIn, telephone, professional networks, industry events and other appropriate business channels.

· Develop personalised outreach based on employer workforce requirements and market conditions.

· Build relationships with HR, Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, Workforce Planning, Operations and senior healthcare management.

· Maintain systematic and persistent follow-up with prospective clients.

· Record all interactions, responses, requirements and next actions within the CRM.

3. Client Acquisition & Lead Generation

· Generate and qualify employer leads based on genuine workforce requirements and commercial potential.

· Establish relationships with prospective healthcare employers and develop opportunities towards recruitment mandates.

· Understand employer workforce requirements, job categories, volumes, qualification and experience requirements, licensing requirements, recruitment timelines, compensation expectations and commercial models.

· Secure qualified meetings and appointments with relevant decision-makers.

· Maintain structured follow-up from initial engagement through qualification, proposal, negotiation and closure.

· Distinguish between general prospects and genuine, commercially viable employer opportunities.

· Build a pipeline of employers capable of generating recurring recruitment requirements.

4. EMT, Paramedic & Emergency Services Business Development

This is an important strategic focus area for the role. The specialist will actively identify and develop opportunities for:

· Emergency Medical Technicians (EMTs)

· Paramedics

· Advanced Care Paramedics

· Critical Care / Intensive Care Paramedics

· Ambulance Nurses

· Emergency Medical Responders

· Other Emergency Medical Services professionals

Potential employer segments include:

· Ambulance service providers

· Emergency medical service organisations

· Hospitals and emergency departments

· Private healthcare groups

· Home healthcare and patient transport organisations

· Industrial and occupational healthcare providers

· Large infrastructure and industrial projects requiring emergency medical support

· Event and venue medical-service providers

· Civil Defence and emergency-response organisations

· Government and government-linked healthcare/emergency-service entities

· Other organisations with regulated EMS workforce requirements

The specialist should develop an understanding of the qualification, licensing and deployment requirements applicable to EMT and paramedic roles in each target market and identify opportunities where Twilight Grey Talent can support workforce requirements.

5. COO / Management Business Visit Facilitation

· Build a qualified client-visit pipeline for the COO/Management across the Middle East.

· Maintain a rolling 60–90 day business-visit pipeline aligned with planned travel schedules.

· Cluster meetings by country, city, geography, employer segment and business potential.

· Secure multiple high-quality appointments within each planned travel window.

· Prioritise meetings based on genuine workforce demand, decision-maker access, potential recruitment volume, commercial opportunity and strategic value.

· Prepare detailed client briefs before each meeting, including employer profile, decision-makers, current workforce requirements, potential recruitment volume, job categories, market intelligence, opportunity value, previous communication, meeting objectives and recommended next steps.

· Coordinate meeting schedules and logistics with prospective clients.

· Ensure the COO/Management has all relevant information before each client meeting.

· Maintain real-time updates on meeting confirmations and changes.

· Manage structured post-visit follow-up.

· Ensure opportunities generated through business visits progress towards proposals, mandates and contracts.

The Acquisition Specialist facilitates and structures the client acquisition process and business visits; the COO/Management will lead senior-level strategic client meetings, commercial negotiations and key relationship development.

6. Market Intelligence, Compliance & Commercial Strategy

· Maintain a working knowledge of country-specific healthcare recruitment regulations, licensing requirements, employment practices, documentation and compliance considerations.

· Monitor healthcare workforce demand, salary levels, recruitment models and market trends.

· Maintain market intelligence specifically relating to nursing, EMT, paramedic, allied healthcare, EMS and ambulance services.

· Research competitor activity and prevailing market/pricing models.

· Identify emerging healthcare workforce opportunities and market segments.

· Support development of country-wise pricing, commercial and recruitment strategies.

· Assess the commercial potential, feasibility and likely margins of prospective opportunities.

· Identify potential risks, regulatory requirements and dependencies.

· Escalate specialist regulatory or compliance matters to management/appropriate specialists when required.

· Provide management with actionable market intelligence to support business decisions.

7. Tools, Platforms & Digital Business Development

· Use LinkedIn and, where available, LinkedIn Sales Navigator to identify healthcare organisations, HR/Talent Acquisition leaders, recruitment heads, procurement contacts and other decision-makers.

· Use Apollo to build targeted B2B prospect lists, identify contacts and support structured outbound campaigns.

· Use RocketReach or comparable contact-intelligence platforms to identify and verify professional contact details where required.

· Use Google Search and Google Maps to research healthcare groups, hospitals, clinics, ambulance providers, EMS organisations, Civil Defence-related entities and other potential employers.

· Use relevant healthcare, government, industry and business portals to research employer information, healthcare licensing frameworks, tenders, workforce requirements and market developments.

· Use company websites and corporate directories to validate organisations, decision-makers, locations and business activities.

· Use appropriate email outreach platforms for structured, personalised B2B outreach and follow-up.

· Maintain all prospect, contact, opportunity, meeting, requirement and follow-up information in the CRM.

· Use Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets for market mapping, employer databases, lead qualification, pipeline analysis and reporting.

· Use Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace for business communication, documentation, meeting coordination and reporting.

· Use WhatsApp Business or other appropriate professional messaging channels for client communication and follow-up where commercially appropriate.

· Use Microsoft Teams, Zoom or equivalent platforms to conduct and coordinate virtual client meetings.

· Use relevant industry associations, healthcare directories, recruitment platforms and Middle East business portals to identify potential employers and market opportunities.

Demonstrated ability to use digital prospecting, contact-intelligence, CRM and market-research tools to identify target organisations, locate decision-makers, verify contact information, conduct structured outreach and build a measurable Middle East client-acquisition pipeline.

8. CRM, Pipeline & Performance Management

· Maintain an accurate CRM/client acquisition pipeline covering prospects, organisations, decision-makers, employer requirements, qualified opportunities, meetings, proposals, negotiations, mandates/contracts and expected business value.

· Ensure every opportunity has a defined status, decision-maker, next action, follow-up date, owner and expected timeline.

· No significant prospect or opportunity should remain in the pipeline without a clearly defined next action.

· Provide weekly management reports on business development activities and outcomes.

· Track conversion through: Lead → Qualified Opportunity → Decision-Maker Engagement → Meeting → Requirement → Proposal → Mandate → Contract.

· Identify stalled opportunities and take appropriate follow-up action.

· Maintain accurate records of all client communication and business-development activity.

9. Candidate Profile Essential

· 2–4 years of relevant experience in B2B Business Development, Client Acquisition, Healthcare Recruitment, Staffing, Manpower or Workforce Solutions.

· Mandatory: Prior experience dealing with healthcare employers in the Middle East.

· Strong understanding of the UAE healthcare market.

· Demonstrable experience in identifying prospects, reaching decision-makers and developing B2B opportunities.

· Strong understanding of healthcare employer structures and recruitment requirements.

· Strong prospecting, appointment-setting and follow-up capability.

· Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

· Strong commercial understanding of pricing, negotiation, margins and business development.

· Good working knowledge of CRM systems, MS Excel/Google Sheets and business reporting.

· Strong organisational skills and ability to manage a high-volume pipeline.

· Ability to work independently and take ownership of business-development outcomes.

· Willingness to work flexible hours when required to accommodate Middle Eastern business timings.

Strong Advantage

· Existing relationships with healthcare employers in the UAE/Middle East.

· Existing network among HR, Talent Acquisition, Recruitment or healthcare decision-makers.

· Experience with EMT, Paramedic, ambulance or EMS recruitment/business development.

· Experience dealing with government, government-linked or large institutional healthcare organisations.

· Experience with Civil Defence, ambulance services or emergency-response organisations.

· Experience in international healthcare recruitment or manpower solutions.

· Experience developing new markets from India.

· Arabic language capability.

Arabic language capability is an advantage but is not mandatory.

10. Working Model

· Location: Bangalore, India

· Work Model: Full-time, Work from Office

· Travel: Primarily office-based.

The role is designed to build and manage the Middle East client-acquisition pipeline from Bangalore. International travel will primarily be undertaken by the COO/Management as part of planned client-development visits.

The specialist will support these visits through market research, prospect identification, appointment setting, client briefing, meeting coordination and post-visit follow-up.

11. What We Are Looking For

This is not a conventional tele-sales or generic lead-generation role.

We are looking for someone who can understand the Middle Eastern healthcare market, identify genuine employer demand, reach the right decision-makers, develop relationships, qualify opportunities and create a high-quality meeting pipeline for the COO/Management.

· Commercially driven

· Persistent

· Structured

· Research-oriented

· Relationship-focused

· Strong in follow-up

· Comfortable with outbound business development

· Accountable for measurable business outcomes

The person should be capable of turning market intelligence into real employer conversations and commercially viable opportunities.

**The operating model is:** Identify the opportunity → Map the organisation → Reach the decision-maker → Understand the requirement → Qualify the opportunity → Secure the meeting → Prepare the COO → Facilitate the visit → Follow through → Win the mandate/contract

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹75,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement

* Internet reimbursement

* Paid time off

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Bengaluru, Karnataka: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Experience:

* Business Development in Healthcare: 2 years (Preferred)

description:
, India  

**Job Family Group:**

Downstream Supply Chain  

**Worker Type:**

Regular  

**Posting Start Date:**

October 2, 2026  

**Business Unit:**

**Experience Level:**

Experienced Professionals  

**Job Description:**

**Where you fit**  
Shell began operations in India more than 80 years ago. At Shell India, we invest in our people through our industry-leading development programmes, which sees our employees thrive and gain access to experts on a local and global level.

To date, we have invested more than US$ 1 billion already in India’s energy sector alone, in socially and environmentally responsible ways. Shell is the only global major to have a fuel retail license in India. Shell aims to establish a new hub in Bangalore, and scale it up over a five-year period.

**What’s the role**

This role will support Lubricants Americas in delivering its growth ambitions. Lubricants Americas falls under the Shell Global Lubricants umbrella - A business advancing towards an accelerated growth commitment by 2026 with a 10% CAGR.

As part of the Lubricants Americas Supply Chain Optimization and Projects organization, this team will drive world class Sales and Operations Planning for North and South America lubricant supply chain network across multiple sales channels (B2B, B2C, Indirect, Retail, GKAs, etc.). The broad product portfolio includes fast-moving consumer goods, products exclusively developed for key customers, and specialty products with niche applications.

**What you’ll be doing**

As the Benchmarking Excellence Specialist within the team, you will play a critical role in ensuring the performances of plant production and supply chain processes remain competitive internally and externally. Through qualitative and quantitative data, you will identify and lead value creation opportunities. This will have to be done while ensuring Lubricants drives towards best in class. You’ll thrive by working closely with global excellence teams, regional production sites, and external resources to meet evolving customer and business needs.

More specifically, your role will include:

* Collaborate with global process quality community, global planning excellence community, and lubricant blending and packaging production site leadership to understand gaps in becoming top quartile supply chain.
* Collect and analyze internal and external qualitative and quantitative information and data to assess the effectiveness of production within North America and the effectiveness of the supply chain processes which include planning systems.
* Benchmark Lubricants Americas E2E performance and develop actionable insights
* Lead and develop a consistent pipeline of value creation projects incorporating the results of the benchmarking study.
Utilize project management tools and techniques while driving accountability in project delivery.  

**What we need from you**

The right candidate is a curious learner who is collaborative, analytical, and has a track record of idea generation and execution. You will work with many stakeholders (globally, regionally, and within individual production sites). You will work with qualitative and quantitative data both internally and externally to provide benchmarking analysis on production performance and process system effectiveness. You will be responsible for developing and executing on the key value creation opportunities as identified in the benchmarking exercise.

When it comes to implementation, it’s your excellent people skills that will make the difference. You will inspire people to make changes that will have a direct impact on our commercial success.

**Additional qualities and experiences that would be beneficial:**

* Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, engineering, or a related field
* With at least 6 – 10 years of experience in supply chain optimization, strategy consulting
* Knowledge of manufacturing and operations (e.g. consumer goods, bottling, automobile) as well as demand and supply planning systems and processes would be valuable to the position
* Comfortable with data analysis (internal and external data)
* Excellent communication skills, ability to build a shared vision and an ability to influence other people at all levels within the organization
* Strong stakeholder management skills
Ability to identify and respond quickly to changing priorities and multi-task  

**The role will be based out of Bangalore, India to support the lubricants business in the North America. The working hours will be partial US hours (Houston) with some flexibility.**

**What we offer**

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
**Digital Marketing Specialist – B2B Marketing Agency**
=======================================================

**Role Overview**
-----------------

Blufig is looking for a Digital Marketing Specialist to join our digital marketing delivery team and contribute to the growth and success of our B2B technology clients.

In this role, you will work across three key digital marketing functions — SEO, Account-Based Marketing (ABM), and Performance Marketing — supporting the planning, execution, optimization, and reporting of integrated B2B marketing campaigns.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of digital marketing fundamentals, be comfortable working across multiple channels, and have a data-driven approach to improving campaign performance and client outcomes.

**Role Objective**
------------------

* SEO & Organic Growth: Execute SEO strategies that improve search visibility, organic traffic, keyword rankings, and overall digital presence for B2B technology clients.
* Account-Based Marketing (ABM): Support and execute targeted ABM campaigns focused on identifying, engaging, and nurturing high-value accounts and decision makers.
* Performance Marketing: Plan, execute, monitor, and optimize paid marketing campaigns across platforms to generate qualified leads and improve campaign ROI.
* Integrated Digital Delivery: Work across SEO, ABM, and paid media to support integrated marketing strategies aligned with client objectives and business goals.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. SEO & Search Marketing**

* Execute on-page and off-page SEO activities for B2B technology clients.
* Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, search intent analysis, and content gap analysis.
* Optimize website pages, landing pages, blogs, and other digital assets for search visibility.
* Support technical SEO activities including site audits, internal linking, metadata optimization, and identifying crawl/indexing issues.
* Develop and implement content optimization recommendations based on search trends and keyword opportunities.
* Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, conversions, and other relevant SEO metrics.
* Identify opportunities to improve organic visibility through content, authority building, and search optimization.
* Stay updated with developments in SEO, AEO, GEO, AI search, and search engine algorithm changes.
* Prepare regular SEO performance reports and provide actionable recommendations.

### **2. Account-Based Marketing (ABM)**

* Support the execution of multi-channel ABM campaigns for B2B technology clients.
* Research and identify target accounts based on ICP, industry, company size, business requirements, and other defined criteria.
* Build and maintain target account lists and support account segmentation.
* Conduct prospect and decision-maker research using platforms such as LinkedIn, HubSpot, intent data platforms, and other relevant tools.
* Support personalized outreach and engagement campaigns across LinkedIn, email, paid media, and content.
* Coordinate with content, design, sales, and marketing teams to develop account-specific campaigns and assets.
* Monitor account engagement, lead quality, response rates, MQLs, SQLs, and pipeline contribution.
* Identify opportunities to improve account engagement and campaign performance.
* Support reporting and analysis of ABM campaigns and provide recommendations for optimization.

### **3. Performance Marketing & Paid Media**

* Plan and execute paid campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta, and relevant third-party media networks.
* Conduct audience research, campaign planning, keyword research, and targeting.
* Set up and manage campaigns, ad groups, audiences, budgets, creatives, and tracking.
* Monitor key performance metrics including CPL, CAC, CTR, conversion rate, ROAS, lead quality, and pipeline contribution.
* Continuously optimize campaigns based on performance data and business objectives.
* Conduct A/B testing of ad creatives, messaging, audiences, landing pages, and campaign strategies.
* Identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency and reduce acquisition costs.
* Work with design and content teams to develop high-performing ad creatives and messaging.
* Ensure campaign tracking, UTM parameters, conversion tracking, and reporting are accurately implemented.

### **4. Campaign Reporting & Analytics**

* Track and analyze performance across SEO, ABM, and Performance Marketing campaigns.
* Prepare regular campaign and client performance reports.
* Translate campaign data into actionable insights and recommendations.
* Identify trends, performance gaps, and opportunities for optimization.
* Monitor lead quality and marketing contribution to the overall sales pipeline.
* Use analytics and marketing platforms to measure campaign effectiveness and ROI.

### **5. Client Delivery & Collaboration**

* Work closely with Account Managers and internal teams to understand client objectives and campaign requirements.
* Support the execution of digital marketing strategies aligned with client business goals.
* Participate in client calls and campaign discussions when required.
* Ensure timely delivery of assigned campaigns, reports, and marketing activities.
* Maintain high standards of quality, accuracy, and attention to detail across all deliverables.
* Proactively identify challenges and recommend solutions to improve campaign outcomes.

### **6. Process Improvement & AI Adoption**

* Identify repetitive marketing tasks and opportunities for automation.
* Leverage AI tools to improve research, content optimization, campaign analysis, reporting, and productivity.
* Experiment with AI-powered tools and workflows to improve efficiency and quality.
* Follow and contribute to Blufig's evolving digital marketing processes, SOPs, and best practices.
* Stay updated with emerging trends across AI, SEO, ABM, Performance Marketing, and B2B digital marketing.

### **Requirements**

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Preferred Qualifications & Experience**

* Experience: 2–5 years of experience in digital marketing, preferably within a B2B technology marketing agency or B2B environment.
* Core Expertise: Hands-on experience in at least two or more of the following areas, with a strong understanding of all three:

o SEO

o Account-Based Marketing (ABM)

o Performance Marketing

* B2B Marketing: Understanding of B2B marketing funnels, lead generation, ICP, buyer journeys, and demand generation.
* SEO Knowledge: Strong understanding of keyword research, on-page SEO, technical SEO fundamentals, content optimization, and SEO analytics.
* ABM Knowledge: Understanding of account research, account targeting, segmentation, personalization, and multi-channel ABM campaigns.
* Paid Media: Hands-on experience with platforms such as Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and/or Meta Ads.
* Analytics: Familiarity with GA4, Google Search Console, HubSpot, and other marketing analytics/reporting platforms.
* Marketing Tools: Experience with SEO tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, Moz, Screaming Frog, or similar platforms is preferred.
* AI Fluency: Comfortable using AI tools to support research, analysis, content optimization, campaign execution, and marketing automation.
* Data-Driven Approach: Ability to analyze campaign performance and convert data into actionable recommendations.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and clients.
* Ownership: Strong attention to detail, willingness to learn, and ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities simultaneously.

**Role Details**
----------------

* Designation: Digital Marketing Specialist
* Department: Digital Marketing
* Reporting To: Marketing Lead / Account Lead
* Location: Bangalore, India (On-site)
* Employment Type: Full-time

**Key Success Metrics**
-----------------------

Performance in this role will be evaluated based on:

* Organic traffic and keyword visibility
* SEO performance and lead generation
* Target account engagement and ABM campaign performance
* MQLs, SQLs, and qualified lead generation
* CPL, CAC, ROAS, and paid campaign efficiency
* Campaign execution and delivery timelines
* Client satisfaction and campaign quality
* Adoption of AI tools and marketing automation
* Continuous improvement in campaign performance and processes

### **Benefits**

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Health insurance for you and your family.
* Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team.
* Exposure to global B2B technology clients.
* Opportunity to work across SEO, ABM, Performance Marketing, AI, and emerging digital marketing technologies.
* Fast-paced and dynamic work environment.
* Opportunity to learn, experiment, and grow within a rapidly evolving digital marketing environment.

title: Business Development Associate
description:
Role Overview

We're looking for a highly motivated **Business Development Executive** to drive customer acquisition, convert leads into customers, and contribute directly to Upride's growth. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys speaking with customers, solving problems, and thrives in a high-growth startup environment.

Key Responsibilities

* Contact and qualify inbound leads through phone calls and WhatsApp.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable Upride services.
* Convert enquiries into successful bookings.
* Follow up consistently with prospective customers.
* Maintain customer information and sales updates in the CRM.
* Coordinate with the operations team for smooth onboarding and scheduling.
* Achieve weekly and monthly sales targets.
* Collect customer feedback to improve the sales process.

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree (preferred but not mandatory).
* 0–3 years of experience in sales, business development, telesales, or customer success.
* Excellent communication skills in **English and Hindi** (Kannada is an added advantage).
* Strong negotiation and persuasion skills.
* Comfortable working in a target-driven startup environment.
* Basic knowledge of Google Sheets and CRM tools is a plus.
* Positive attitude, ownership mindset, and willingness to learn.

What You'll Get

* Competitive fixed salary + attractive performance incentives.
* Fast career growth in a high-growth startup.
* Direct mentorship from the founders.
* Opportunity to work on solving real-world problems at scale.
* A young, collaborative, and energetic work culture.

Work Details

* **Location:** MG Road, Bengaluru
* **Mode:** Work from Office
* **Working Days:** Monday to Friday
* **Timings:** 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM

Why Join Upride?

At Upride, you'll do more than just sell—you'll help build one of India's fastest-growing mobility and driving education platforms. If you're ambitious, enjoy interacting with customers, and want to grow quickly in your career, we'd love to hear from you.

**Apply now and become a part of our journey to transform driving education in India.**

Pay: ₹17,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month
